text:
Situation: Meropenem supply is constrained at Corvale Lakeside with 29 units on hand at 2.6 units per day, providing 11 days of supply. Corvale East holds 337 units at 15.1 units per day for 22 days. Corvale General holds 425 units at 15.2 units per day for 28 days. The drug is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show Qilu Antibiotics Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., the manufacturer for NDC 51810050302, was inspected on 2026-07-16 and classified VAI, with the classification known on 2026-10-05. Earlier inspections of the same facility on 2015-09-22 and 2023-05-30 were also classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory at Lakeside is critically low. East and General have adequate supply for 22 and 28 days respectively. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Gland Pharma Limited; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase from WG Critical Care, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to initiate purchase from ARMAS PHARMACEUTICALS INC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC and B. Braun Medical Inc. as secondary options; requires P&T committee approval if selected.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
